en: Enough food for the next leg when you cannot afford it.
zh_CN: 负担不起时，提供下一段航程所需的食物。

en: Essential repairs so the ship can sail.
zh_CN: 必要的维修，让船只能够起航。
为受伤船员提供基本护理。

en: Build one ship, raise a crew, and become the strongest captain on the seven seas.
zh_CN: 打造一艘船，培养一支船员队伍，成为七海最强的船长。

en: Relic thieves pick over Sunken Spires. Clear them.
zh_CN: 遗物窃贼在沉没尖塔翻找。清理他们。

en: Relic Dock's divers have news. Visit the dock.
zh_CN: 遗物码头的潜水员带来了消息。去码头看看。

en: The Trench Sanctum hides what the seal keeps. Clear it.
zh_CN: 海沟圣所里藏着封印守护之物。清理圣所。

en: Ashport needs Abyss Alloy to reinforce the seal.
zh_CN: 灰港需要深渊合金来加固封印。

en: Vale Ash waits at the Ashen Seal. Break through.
zh_CN: 维尔·灰船长在灰烬封印等你。突破过去。

en: Cutpurses run Heron Isle. Clear them out.
zh_CN: 扒手横行于苍鹭岛。把他们赶出去。

en: The Silkmarket guilds want a word. Visit them.
zh_CN: 丝绸市场的行会想和你谈谈。去拜访他们。

en: An old family crypt hides the stolen charter. Clear it.
zh_CN: 古老的家族墓穴里藏着被盗的特许状。清理墓穴。

en: Crownport needs Crown Silk for the charter ceremony.
zh_CN: 王冠港的特许状仪式需要王冠丝绸。

en: Cassian Crest challenges you at the Crown Tourney.
zh_CN: 卡西安·纹章船长在王冠比武场向你挑战。

en: Gull raiders have taken Gull Rock. Clear them out and the harbor will take you seriously.
zh_CN: 海鸥劫掠者占领了鸥岩。把他们赶走，港口才会认真对待你。

en: Word of your win reaches Saltmarsh Landing. Sail there and meet the dockmasters.
zh_CN: 你获胜的消息传到了盐沼码头。驶往那里，去见码头管理者。

en: Something stirs in the Brine Cellars beneath the old lookout. Clear the cellars.
zh_CN: 旧瞭望台下的盐水地窖里有东西在蠢动。清理地窖。

en: Brightquay needs Saltleaf Grain to restock after the raids. Bring it home.
zh_CN: 明港在劫掠之后需要盐叶谷来补充存粮。把它带回来。

en: Captain Mira Gull waits at the Trial Ring. Win her wager and the next sea opens.
zh_CN: 米拉·鸥船长在试炼环等你。赢下她的赌约，下一片海域就会开放。

en: Imps swarm Basalt Isle. Clear the island so the forges can breathe.
zh_CN: 小恶魔成群占据了玄武岛。清理这座岛，让熔炉重新呼吸。

en: Ashfall Harbor has gone quiet. Sail there and find out why.
zh_CN: 落灰港陷入了沉寂。驶往那里查明原因。

en: The Forge Depths are erupting with golems. Clear them.
zh_CN: 熔炉深处涌出了大量魔像。清理那里。

en: Cinderport needs Ember Ore to relight its great forge.
zh_CN: 烬港需要余烬矿石来重新点燃它的大熔炉。

en: Flint Cinder holds the Crucible. Beat him in the captain trial.
zh_CN: 弗林特·烬船长坐镇熔炉竞技场。在船长试炼中击败他。

en: Shard fencers guard Lens Isle. Clear them.
zh_CN: 碎晶剑客守卫着透镜岛。清理他们。

en: Mirrorbay's lights have dimmed. Visit the harbor.
zh_CN: 镜湾的灯光暗了下来。前往港口看看。

en: The Refraction Maze bends light and sense. Clear it.
zh_CN: 折射迷宫扭曲光线与感知。清理它。

en: Prismhaven needs Prism Quartz for its lighthouse.
zh_CN: 棱光港的灯塔需要棱光石英。

en: Selene Prism awaits at the Prism Court. Shatter her illusions.
zh_CN: 瑟琳·棱光船长在棱光宫廷等候。打破她的幻象。

en: Gate duelists guard Zenith Cay. Defeat them.
zh_CN: 关门决斗者守卫着天顶岛。击败他们。

en: The Conclave Harbor invites you. Answer the summons.
zh_CN: 议会港向你发出邀请。回应召唤。

en: The Compass Vault holds the way to the final trial. Clear it.
zh_CN: 罗盘宝库藏着通往最终试炼的道路。清理它。

en: Horizon Gate needs Horizon Glass for the final beacon.
zh_CN: 地平线之门需要地平线玻璃来点亮最后的信标。

en: Aurelia Dawn, the reigning champion, waits at the Horizon Arena.
zh_CN: 卫冕冠军奥蕾莉亚·晨船长在地平线竞技场等你。

en: Ring raiders nest on Bone Reef. Clear them.
zh_CN: 环礁掠夺者在骨礁筑巢。清理他们。

en: The Migration Post tracks the titan. Visit it.
zh_CN: 迁徙驿站一直在追踪巨兽。前往那里。

en: The Coral Colossus has woken. Clear it.
zh_CN: 珊瑚巨像苏醒了。清理它。

en: Ringhold needs Leviathan Scale for its sea wall.
zh_CN: 环堡需要利维坦鳞片来修筑海堤。

en: Brakka Reef waits in the Ring Arena.
zh_CN: 布拉卡·礁船长在环礁竞技场等你。

en: Night stalkers haunt Echo Atoll. Clear it.
zh_CN: 夜行者在回声环礁出没。清理那里。

en: Dusk Mooring's sailors have fallen asleep. Visit them.
zh_CN: 暮色泊地的水手们都睡着了。去看看他们。

en: The Dream Labyrinth shifts with every step. Clear it.
zh_CN: 梦境迷宫每走一步都会变化。清理它。

en: Lanternport needs Moon Ink to rewrite its charts.
zh_CN: 灯港需要月墨来重绘海图。

en: Orin Lantern holds the Moonwake Stage. Wake him from his dream.
zh_CN: 奥林·灯笼船长占据着月痕舞台。把他从梦中唤醒。

en: Squall runners raid Squall Isle. Clear it.
zh_CN: 疾风奔袭者在疾风岛劫掠。清理那里。

en: Beacon Rest has lost its light. Sail there.
zh_CN: 信标驿失去了灯光。驶往那里。

en: The Tempest Caverns roar with wind. Clear them.
zh_CN: 暴风洞窟中狂风怒吼。清理洞窟。

en: Gale Harbor needs Stormwood to rebuild its piers.
zh_CN: 疾风港需要风暴木来重建码头。

en: Nessa Gale waits in the Eye of the Storm.
zh_CN: 内莎·疾风船长在风暴之眼等你。

en: Vine stalkers hold Tanglewood Isle. Clear a path.
zh_CN: 藤蔓潜伏者占据了缠木岛。开出一条路。

en: Fernwater Post sends a call for help. Answer it.
zh_CN: 蕨水驿站发来求救。回应他们。

en: Roots are choking the Thornroot Caves. Cut them back.
zh_CN: 根须正在堵塞荆根洞窟。把它们砍掉。

en: Rootharbor needs Verdant Resin to seal its hulls.
zh_CN: 根港需要翠绿树脂来密封船体。

en: Rook Fern waits in the Verdant Arena. Prove yourself.
zh_CN: 鲁克·蕨船长在翠绿竞技场等你。证明你自己。

en: Levels, mastery, equipment, pets, and charts are never lost.
zh_CN: 等级、精通度、装备、宠物和海图永远不会丢失。

en: Lost {gold} unbanked gold and {materials} materials. The crew was carried back to {location}.
zh_CN: 损失了 {gold} 未入账金币和 {materials} 材料。船员被送回了 {location}。
暴击！{src} 用{skill}击中 {tgt}，造成 {n} 点伤害。

en: The legend rises again for an encore!
zh_CN: 传说再度站起，返场再战！
{src} 为 {tgt} 恢复 {n} 点生命。
{src} 用{skill}击中 {tgt}，造成 {n} 点伤害。
{tgt} 受到 {src} 的 {n} 点反伤。
陷阱对 {tgt} 造成 {n} 点伤害。

en: Click an enemy to focus fire.

zh_CN: 已暂停——调整战术后继续。

en: Gold and materials go to the unbanked ledger until you dock.
zh_CN: 金币和材料会先记入未入账，停靠港口后入账。

en: The battle could not be resolved. Your game was not changed.
zh_CN: 无法结算这场战斗。你的游戏没有被改动。

en: The crew needs {n}s to withdraw. Retreating is free but forfeits rewards.
zh_CN: 船员需要 {n} 秒撤离。撤退不消耗任何东西，但会放弃奖励。

en: You withdrew safely. Nothing was lost and no stamina was spent.
zh_CN: 你安全撤离了。没有任何损失，也没有消耗体力。

en: Resolve the rest of the battle instantly with the current tactics.
zh_CN: 以当前战术立即结算剩余战斗。

en: No light reaches it, so it makes its own.
zh_CN: 没有光能到达它，于是它自己造光。

en: Its rings are packed with ash from a hundred burned fleets.
zh_CN: 体环里塞满上百支被焚舰队的灰。

en: Its wake is a ribbon of colour across a sky that has no night.
zh_CN: 它的尾迹是在没有夜晚的天空上划过的彩色缎带。

en: A segmented bulk that reshapes the wreck it nests in. The hull learned to fear it.
zh_CN: 分节的巨躯把栖身的沉船挤得变形，船骨学会了怕它。

en: It hunts beneath the mangrove canopy, where the water is green and blind.
zh_CN: 它在红树林冠下狩猎，那里的水是绿色而盲目的。

en: A jelly lit from within by a coal that refuses to go out.
zh_CN: 体内燃着一块不肯熄灭的炭火。

en: Its wings are made of cooled ash. Where it lands, the wood remembers fire.
zh_CN: 双翼由冷却的灰烬构成。它落过的地方，木头会记起火焰。

en: A serpent that hoards coins it cannot spend, in a nest it cannot leave.
zh_CN: 一条囤积着花不出去的金币、守着一座离不开的巢的蛇。

en: It has swallowed so many coins that its bell rings when it moves.
zh_CN: 吞下太多金币，移动时伞盖会叮当作响。

en: It was old when the first ship was built. It is still waiting at the gate.
zh_CN: 第一艘船造好时它已古老。它仍在门前等待。

en: Its rings are the colour of a sunrise seen from below the sea.
zh_CN: 体环是自海底仰望日出的颜色。

en: It has no face of its own, so it borrows the face of whoever is dreaming.
zh_CN: 它没有自己的脸，于是借用每一个做梦者的脸。

en: It drifts through sleep, and sleep drifts through it.
A beast so old that a forest has taken root on its back.
zh_CN: 一头老到背上长出一片森林的巨兽。

en: It wears the treasury it swallowed. Every coin is a scale.
zh_CN: 它穿着自己吞下的宝库，每一枚金币都是一片鳞。

en: Its underside is plated with stolen leaf and coin.
zh_CN: 它的腹面镶满偷来的金箔与钱币。

en: A living tube of clear glass. You see your own blood move inside it.
zh_CN: 一截活着的透明玻璃管。你能看见自己的血在里面流动。

en: A crab whose shell grew rich on shipwreck gold. It has never once been caught.
zh_CN: 一只靠沉船金子养出金壳的蟹，从未被真正抓住。

en: It has slept beneath the harbour for a hundred years, and the harbour has learned to sleep around it.
zh_CN: 它在港湾之下沉睡百年，整座港湾都学会了绕着它入眠。

en: It leaps farther than the eye can follow and lands on the other side of the light.
zh_CN: 它跃得比目光更远，落在光的另一侧。

en: Sailors have charted it as an island three times.
zh_CN: 水手已经三次把它标成岛屿。

en: A bell the size of a chapel, drifting with the world serpent's pulse.
zh_CN: 一座礼拜堂大小的伞盖，随世界海蛇的脉搏漂流。

en: Its wings hold the last light of a moon that set long ago.
zh_CN: 双翼盛着一轮早已落下的月亮的最后的光。

en: Cut one head from the molten dark and two more rise to take its place.
zh_CN: 从熔岩的黑暗里斩下一颗头，会有两颗新的升起来。

en: It swims through molten stone as if the sea were only a rumour.
zh_CN: 它在熔石中游动，仿佛海水只是一个传闻。

en: The swamp closes over its back and calls it ground.
zh_CN: 沼泽合拢在它背上，把它当作地面。

en: A ray with no colour of its own, only the sea it borrows.
zh_CN: 没有自己颜色的鳐，只映出它借来的海。

en: Its wings are the colour of a cloud crossing the moon.
zh_CN: 双翼是云穿过月亮时的颜色。

en: It burrows through the space behind closed eyes.
zh_CN: 它在闭上的眼睛后面的空间里掘进。

en: A deep angler that has eaten so much light it has become pale.
zh_CN: 一条吃了太多光的深海鮟鱇，自己变得苍白。

en: It has no shadow, because nothing down here casts one.
zh_CN: 它没有影子，因为这里没有什么能投下影子。

en: Seven colours drift inside it, none of them its own.
zh_CN: 七种颜色在它体内漂浮，没有一种属于它。

en: Its scales are mirrors. Look too long and you will see yourself losing.
zh_CN: 鳞片是镜子。看得太久，你会看见自己落败的样子。

en: It carries a reef on its back, and the reef carries hunters.
zh_CN: 它背上驮着礁石，礁石上驮着猎手。

en: It is not one animal but a school of glass splinters keeping a shape.
zh_CN: 它不是一只动物，而是一群维持着形状的玻璃碎片。

en: Its shell is made of the plates of things that tried to eat it.
zh_CN: 它的壳由试图吃掉它的东西的甲片拼成。

en: It glides a hand's breadth above the seabed, wings silent, eyes never closing.
zh_CN: 它贴着海床滑行，翼无声，眼不闭。

en: A breathing cloud of spores shaped like a bell. It is never alone.
zh_CN: 一团钟形的呼吸孢子云。它从不孤单。

en: Every breath in the Maw carries her children. Every wreck is her nursery.
zh_CN: 翠喉的每一口气都带着她的子嗣，每一艘沉船都是她的育婴房。

en: It rides the underside of waves, faster than the wind above.
zh_CN: 它贴着浪底滑翔，比上方的风更快。

en: A jelly full of small lights, each one a place it has never been.
zh_CN: 一只装满小光点的水母，每一点都是它未曾到过的地方。

en: Its bell is a thunderhead. Its tendrils are rain that stings.
zh_CN: 伞盖是一团雷云，触须是会蜇人的雨。

en: A younger roc with a longer temper and a shorter memory.
zh_CN: 一头更年轻的巨鹏，脾气更长，记性更短。

en: A palm-sized hunter that only feels brave in a crowd.
zh_CN: 掌心大小的猎手，只有在成群时才觉得勇敢。

en: It nests in the eye of the storm and has never touched the sea.
zh_CN: 它筑巢于风暴之眼，从未触碰过海面。

en: Each segment holds a charge. When it dies, the storm gets it back.
zh_CN: 每一节都蓄着电。它死去时，风暴会收回这些电。

en: A drifting bell of translucent flesh. Its sting lingers long after the light fades.
zh_CN: 半透明的钟形身躯随潮漂流，螫伤在光芒消失后仍会作痛。

en: It is longer than the wreck it circles and older than the trench.
zh_CN: 它比它环绕的沉船更长，比海沟更古老。

en: It nests inside a sunken vault and wears the door as a crown.
zh_CN: 它筑巢于沉没的金库，把库门当作王冠。

en: Its lure is a small sun. The dark around it is not empty.
zh_CN: 它的诱灯是一颗小太阳。它周围的黑暗并不空。

en: The ring is its body. The currents are its breath. The sea is its dream.
zh_CN: 环礁是它的身体，洋流是它的呼吸，海是它的梦。

en: Drag to pan. Click a charted location to plan a route.
zh_CN: 拖动以平移海图，点击已知地点规划航线。

en: Beastkeeper branch: pets that guard the pack.
zh_CN: 驯兽师分支：守护群体的宠物。

en: Duelist branch: whirling strikes across a lane.
zh_CN: 决斗者分支：横扫一排的旋舞斩击。
近身打手，擅长击碎护甲。

en: Brawler branch: shatters armor and shields.
zh_CN: 拳斗士分支：粉碎护甲和护盾。

en: Guard branch: heavy armor that slams back.
zh_CN: 护卫分支：会反击的重甲。

en: Duelist branch: calls out and topples bosses.
zh_CN: 决斗者分支：点名挑战并击倒首领。

en: Feeds the crew in battle and saves food at sea.
zh_CN: 在战斗中给船员加餐，在海上节省食物。

en: Spearfighter branch: leaping strikes from above.
zh_CN: 枪兵分支：从空中跃下突刺。

en: Fast blade fighter who punishes single targets.
zh_CN: 迅捷的剑士，专门惩罚单个目标。
工匠分支：炮塔与装甲板。

en: Cook branch: grand feasts that lift the crew.
zh_CN: 厨师分支：振奋全队的盛宴。
拳斗士分支：擒抱与摔投。

en: Front-line protector with shields and taunts.
zh_CN: 用盾牌和嘲讽守护前线。

en: Guard branch: unbreakable wall for the whole line.
zh_CN: 护卫分支：守护整条战线的坚墙。

en: Ranged damage from the back line.
Spearfighter branch: drags foes into reach.
zh_CN: 枪兵分支：把敌人拖进攻击范围。
秘术师分支：驱散与守护。

en: Medic branch: steady regeneration for all.
zh_CN: 医师分支：为全队持续再生。

en: Keeps the crew alive with heals and cleansing.
zh_CN: 用治疗和净化让船员保持战斗。
使用范围攻击的元素施法者。

en: Reads the sea: marks targets and avoids trouble.
zh_CN: 读懂大海：标记目标、避开麻烦。
领航员分支：捷径与伏击。

en: Cook branch: supplies and stamina at sea.
zh_CN: 厨师分支：海上的补给与体力。

en: Quartermaster branch: more gold from every fight.
zh_CN: 军需官分支：每场战斗获得更多金币。
旗帜、增益和更好的战利品。

en: Gunner branch: precise shots at weak points.
zh_CN: 枪手分支：精准射击弱点。

en: Gunner branch: volleys that cover every lane.
zh_CN: 枪手分支：覆盖所有排的齐射。

en: Reach fighter who strikes past the front line.
zh_CN: 长柄战士，可越过前排攻击。

en: Quartermaster branch: holds the colors high.

zh_CN: 医师分支：强力的急救治疗。

en: Navigator branch: turns the tide of battle.
Cinderback notes: red, red, yellow hatches a Prime companion. All signatures are now in the Pet Lab.
zh_CN: 烬背笔记：按红、红、黄的顺序喂养，可完美孵化出伙伴。全部特征序列已记录在宠物研究室。

en: Cloudray notes: yellow, blue, yellow hatches a Prime companion. All signatures are now in the Pet Lab.
zh_CN: 云鳐笔记：按黄、蓝、黄的顺序喂养，可完美孵化出伙伴。全部特征序列已记录在宠物研究室。

en: Dreammoth notes: purple, purple, yellow hatches a Prime explorer. All signatures are now in the Pet Lab.
zh_CN: 梦蛾笔记：按紫、紫、黄的顺序喂养，可完美孵化出探索者。全部特征序列已记录在宠物研究室。

en: Glasswing notes: blue, blue, yellow hatches a Prime ship helper. All signatures are now in the Pet Lab.
zh_CN: 琉璃翼笔记：按蓝、蓝、黄的顺序喂养，可完美孵化出船上帮手。全部特征序列已记录在宠物研究室。

en: Gloomjaw notes: red, purple, red hatches a Prime companion. All signatures are now in the Pet Lab.
zh_CN: 幽颚笔记：按红、紫、红的顺序喂养，可完美孵化出伙伴。全部特征序列已记录在宠物研究室。

en: Mossling notes: green, green, blue hatches a Prime ship helper. All signatures are now in the Pet Lab.
zh_CN: 苔仔笔记：按绿、绿、蓝的顺序喂养，可完美孵化出船上帮手。全部特征序列已记录在宠物研究室。

en: Pearlcub notes: white, white, green hatches a Prime explorer. All signatures are now in the Pet Lab.
zh_CN: 珍珠幼兽笔记：按白、白、绿的顺序喂养，可完美孵化出探索者。全部特征序列已记录在宠物研究室。

en: Shellwarden notes: green, blue, green hatches a Prime ship helper. All signatures are now in the Pet Lab.

en: An ingot that drinks lamplight and gives back nothing.
zh_CN: 一块吸走灯光却什么也不返还的合金。

en: A shell plated in gold by a jeweller with more money than sense.
zh_CN: 被一位钱多过脑的珠宝匠镀成金色的贝壳。

en: A smooth bead worn by dock children for luck.
zh_CN: 码头孩子佩戴的光滑珠子，据说能带来好运。

en: A flower of cooled slag, prized by collectors for its colour.
zh_CN: 冷却矿渣凝成的花，因色泽奇异而受收藏家追捧。

en: A marble that splits sunlight into seven thin blades.
zh_CN: 把阳光劈成七道细刃的弹珠。

en: It splits dawn into colours no sailor has named.
zh_CN: 把黎明拆成水手尚未命名的颜色。

en: A tooth worn smooth by a hundred years of tide.
zh_CN: 被百年潮水磨得光滑的牙。

en: A pearl that grows heavier with every nightmare it eats.
zh_CN: 每吞下一个噩梦就重一分的珍珠。

en: A glass eye that clouds before lightning strikes.
zh_CN: 闪电落下前会起雾的玻璃眼。

en: A seedpod that glows faintly when held to the ear.
zh_CN: 贴近耳边时会发出微光的种荚。

en: A door at the bottom of the trench is sealed from the inside.
zh_CN: 海沟底部的门，是从里面封住的。

en: The founding families bought the shoals with a promise they never intended to keep.
zh_CN: 创始家族用一句从未打算兑现的承诺买下了浅滩。

en: The old crypt is said to hold a coin that always returns.
zh_CN: 据说旧墓穴里有一枚总会回到主人手中的硬币。

en: The first settlers found a sheltered bay and swore the tide would never take it.
zh_CN: 最初的定居者发现了一处避风湾，并立誓不让潮水夺走它。

en: A drowned cartographer's last map showed a route no living sailor remembers.
zh_CN: 一位溺亡制图师的最后一张海图，标着无人记得的航路。

en: Miners followed a singing vent and found a cavern full of molten glass.
zh_CN: 矿工追随歌唱的喷口，发现了一座装满熔玻璃的洞窟。

en: The old forge clans buried their dead with hammers, not coins.
zh_CN: 古老的锻造氏族用锤子而非钱币陪葬。

en: Sailors say a fleet of glass ships once crossed the Current and vanished.
zh_CN: 水手说，一支玻璃船队曾横渡洋流，随后消失。

en: The refraction queen keeps every reflection she has ever stolen.
zh_CN: 折射女王收藏着她偷走的所有倒影。

en: Beyond the horizon gate, the sea ends and something else begins.
zh_CN: 天际门之后，海结束，别的东西开始。

en: The ring is not a reef; it is the ribs of something older than the sea.
zh_CN: 环礁不是礁，是比海更古老之物的肋骨。

en: The observatory charts a sky that does not exist above the sea.
zh_CN: 天文台描绘着一片海面上不存在的星空。

en: Three keepers drowned; the beacon still burns.
zh_CN: 三任守塔人溺亡，灯塔仍在燃烧。

en: The Beacon That Would Not Die
A captain's log written in one hand, then another, then another.
zh_CN: 一本船长日志，先是几种笔迹，最后只剩一种。

en: A galleon swallowed by the jungle, its cannon now a planter.
zh_CN: 一艘被丛林吞没的大帆船，火炮成了花盆。

en: The roots remember every sailor who fell in the Maw.
zh_CN: 根须记得每一个倒在翠喉的水手。

en: Cold iron from a trench that has never seen daylight.
zh_CN: 取自从未见过日光的海沟的冷铁。

en: Smoke-grey glass that reveals the weak points in armour.
zh_CN: 烟灰色的镜片，能映出甲胄的薄弱处。

en: A coin stamped on both sides with the same face.
zh_CN: 两面都铸着同一张脸的硬币。

en: A pane of glass that holds the first light of morning.
zh_CN: 盛着清晨第一缕光的玻璃片。

en: A marble that rolls uphill when no one watches.
zh_CN: 没人看时会向坡上滚的弹珠。

en: Warm to the touch, it pulls blades toward an enemy's guard.
zh_CN: 触手温热，能把刀锋引向敌人的破绽。

en: An ember that has outlived every forge in the Reach.
zh_CN: 一粒比烬火峡所有锻炉都活得久的余烬。

en: The seal of a merchant house that no longer exists.
zh_CN: 一个已不存在的商会的印玺。

en: Its ring once guided fishing boats home through the fog.
zh_CN: 铃声曾在浓雾中指引渔船归港。

en: It points at the place where the sun is always rising.
zh_CN: 它指向太阳永远升起的地方。

en: A pearl the size of a fist, heavy with drowned songs.
zh_CN: 拳头大的珍珠，盛满溺亡者的歌。

en: A scrap of sailcloth that reflects the sea instead of the sky.
zh_CN: 一块映海而不映天的帆布。

en: It burns with a light that only dreamers can see.
zh_CN: 它燃烧着只有做梦者能看见的光。

en: Its needle points down, always down.
It measures the angle of light, not the stars.
zh_CN: 它测量的是光的夹角，而非星辰。

en: A shard that shows a different horizon in each facet.
zh_CN: 每一面都映出不同地平线的碎片。

en: Still warm, still waiting for soil.
zh_CN: 仍有余温，仍在等待土壤。

en: A cloudy prism that turns sea light into a warm, steady glow.
zh_CN: 浑浊的棱镜，把海光折成温暖而稳定的微光。

en: A scale from the world serpent, still warm.
zh_CN: 世界海蛇的一片鳞，仍有余温。

en: Every debt written in it is still owed.
zh_CN: 写在上面的每一笔债，至今仍有人偿还。

en: A vial of glowing spores that never settle.
zh_CN: 一瓶永不停歇的发光孢子。

en: A stormglass that fills with lightning instead of crystals.
zh_CN: 一块装满闪电而非晶体的风暴玻璃。

en: An anchor that has held through nine typhoons.
zh_CN: 曾扛过九场台风的老锚。

en: A small idol carved from a tree that grew through a shipwreck.
zh_CN: 用穿透沉船生长的树木雕成的小神像。

en: A feather that crackles before every storm.
zh_CN: 每场风暴来临前都会噼啪作响的羽毛。

en: A brass compass that always points toward the nearest safe harbour.
zh_CN: 黄铜罗盘，总是指向最近的安全港湾。

zh_CN: 击败稀有怪物极光翼蛇的证明。

The captain trial opens after the main arc.
zh_CN: 船长试炼将在主线完成后开放。

zh_CN: 暂时无法前往该目的地。将鼠标悬停在按钮上查看原因，或选择其他目的地。

en: You have landed. Click a glowing room marker and the party walks there. Fights and searches cost stamina (top bar).
zh_CN: 已登陆。点击发光的房间标记，队伍就会走过去。战斗和搜索会消耗体力（见顶部栏）。

en: Free emergency aid is available at this port.
zh_CN: 本港口可提供免费紧急援助。

en: Always available: return to your last safe port for free.
zh_CN: 随时可用：免费返回最近的安全港口。
缺少必需设施或无法到达：{facility}。

en: More crew than berths. Build or upgrade Crew Quarters before departing.
zh_CN: 船员超出床位。出航前请建造或升级船员舱。

en: Optional challenges cost stamina. Sailing, forced fights, retreating, cleared rooms, and returning to port are free. Only food rations and supplies restore stamina.
zh_CN: 可选挑战会消耗体力。航行、被迫战斗、撤退、已清理的房间和返回港口都不消耗体力。只有口粮和补给能恢复体力。

en: A frigate with forecastle and quarterdeck, and three interior levels: gun deck, orlop and hold.
zh_CN: 一艘护卫舰，带艏楼和后甲板，船舱内有炮甲板、下层甲板和货舱三层。

en: A towering galleon with a poop deck over the quarterdeck and three broad interior levels.
zh_CN: 一艘高耸的大帆船，后甲板之上还有艉楼，船舱内有三层宽敞的楼层。

en: A stout sloop: an open weather deck for boarding fights above a gun deck and a hold for rooms.
zh_CN: 一艘结实的单桅船：上方是供接舷战使用的露天甲板，下方的炮甲板和货舱用来布置房间。

en: A brig with a raised quarterdeck, a long gun deck and a deeper hold.
zh_CN: 一艘双桅船，有抬高的后甲板、更长的炮甲板和更深的货舱。

en: Safest; best for ranged and support.
zh_CN: 最安全；适合远程和支援。

en: You can change the language later from the System menu. The game restarts to apply it; saves are shared between languages.
zh_CN: 之后可以在「系统」菜单中更改语言。切换语言会重新启动游戏；两种语言共用同一份存档。

en: A deeper site guarded by a boss.
zh_CN: 由首领把守的深处地点。

en: Rooms with resources, battles, and a hidden hollow.
zh_CN: 有资源、战斗和隐藏秘洞的房间。

en: Safe harbor: trade, recruit, invest, and bank cargo.
zh_CN: 安全的港湾：交易、招募、投资，以及货物入账。

en: A hidden place tied to the sea's pet family.
zh_CN: 与本海域宠物族群相关的隐藏地点。
入账 {gold} 金币和 {materials} 材料。

en: {crew} joined the crew after the battle (formerly {enemy}).
zh_CN: {crew} 在战后加入了船队（原为{enemy}）。
重复的{item}转化为 {n} 枚古物碎片。
战败。损失了 {gold} 金币和 {materials} 材料。
拆除了{facility}（+{gold} 金币，+{materials} 材料）。
码头打工赚了 {gold} 金币。

en: No room for {item}; sold it for {n} gold.
zh_CN: {item}没有地方放，以 {n} 金币卖掉了。

en: {n} food did not fit in the pantry.
zh_CN: 有 {n} 份食物放不进食物储藏室。

en: You take command of a small ship at Brightquay.
zh_CN: 你在明港接管了一艘小船。

en: Your explorer pet found a secret place.
zh_CN: 你的探索宠物发现了一处秘境。

en: You are now the Strongest Captain of the Seven Seas.
zh_CN: 你现在是七海最强船长了。

en: The shipwrights moved {n} rooms off the exposed deck into the hull below.
zh_CN: 船匠把 {n} 个房间从露天甲板搬进了下方船舱。

en: {n} supplies did not fit in the hold.
zh_CN: 有 {n} 份补给放不进货舱。
在{region}的船长试炼中战胜了 {rival}。

en: Drag to pan · wheel to zoom · click a marker to plan a voyage
zh_CN: 拖动平移 · 滚轮缩放 · 点击标记规划航行

en: Emergency Return takes you to your last safe port for free, even with no food or gold.
zh_CN: 紧急返航可免费带你回到最近的安全港口，即使没有食物或金币。
还有 {n} 个未标记的地点

en: Select a destination on the chart
No other charted places in this sea yet.
zh_CN: 这片海域暂无其他已标注地点。

en: Win the previous sea's captain trial to open this sea.
zh_CN: 赢得上一片海域的船长试炼即可开放此海域。

en: Select a revealed location on the chart to plan a voyage.
zh_CN: 在海图上选择一个已发现的地点来规划航行。
赢得{region}的船长试炼后开放

en: Once per battle, heals {pct} max HP when low
zh_CN: 每场战斗一次，生命低时恢复 {pct} 最大生命
每次出航节省 {n} 食物

en: {pct} chance to take hits for allies

zh_CN: 开战时拥有 {n} 技能能量

en: Team starts battles with a {pct} max-HP shield
zh_CN: 全队开战时获得 {pct} 最大生命的护盾

en: You hold the title. Legendary challenges are open in the late seas.
zh_CN: 你已获得称号。后期海域的传说挑战已开放。

en: Target: an uncharted location — explore to reveal it
zh_CN: 目标：尚未标记的地点——继续探索以发现它

en: Captain trial at {location} opens after the main arc. Rival: {rival}.
zh_CN: {location} 的船长试炼将在主线完成后开放。对手：{rival}。
{location} 的船长试炼已开放。对手：{rival}。

en: Fights beside one crew member in battle.
zh_CN: 在战斗中陪伴一名船员作战。

en: Scouts new places and finds secrets.
Works a ship facility, boosting it.
zh_CN: 在船上设施工作，提升设施效果。

en: Needs a Pet Lab and pet level {level}.
zh_CN: 需要宠物研究室，且宠物达到 {level} 级。

en: Evolution is permanent and keeps every assignment.
zh_CN: 进化是永久的，并会保留所有分派。

en: Feed up to three ingredients or specialties in order. The same egg with the same order always hatches the same pet.
zh_CN: 按顺序喂入最多三种食材或特产。同一枚蛋、同样的顺序，孵出的宠物总是相同。

en: Not a helper by nature: works at half effect.
zh_CN: 天生不是帮手：效果减半。

en: Eggs come from secret rooms, island hollows, side quests, and port markets (level 3).
zh_CN: 宠物蛋来自秘密房间、岛屿秘洞、支线任务和港口市场（3 级）。

en: Find this family's clue to learn its recipe signatures.
zh_CN: 找到这个族群的线索，就能得知它的配方特征序列。

en: Free help when you cannot afford the basics. You can always recover.
zh_CN: 负担不起基本开销时的免费帮助。你永远都能重新站起来。
天赋未显示（需要酒馆 2 级）

en: Contracts rotate every three days. Up to three can be active.
zh_CN: 委托每三天轮换一次。最多可同时进行三个。
奖励：{gold} 金币 · {materials} 材料
其他港口进行中的委托

en: Nothing new today. Return another day.
zh_CN: 今日没有新货，改日再来。

en: Crew take a shift on the docks. Takes 4 hours, costs nothing.
zh_CN: 船员去码头干一班活。耗时 4 小时，不花任何费用。

en: Dock work is only offered when you are short on gold.
zh_CN: 只有在金币不足时才能去码头打工。

en: Food is charged once when you depart and is never refunded.
zh_CN: 食物只在出航时扣除一次，且不会退还。

en: Each level permanently unlocks the listed service at this port.
zh_CN: 每提升一级，都会在本港口永久解锁所列服务。

en: No equipment on sale at this market level.
zh_CN: 当前市场等级没有出售装备。

en: No recipes known. Recipes come from side quests and bosses.
zh_CN: 还不知道任何配方。配方来自支线任务和首领。

en: No side quests at this port.
Sail to a port to trade, recruit, and invest. Your last safe port is {location}.
zh_CN: 驶向港口即可交易、招募和投资。你最近的安全港口是 {location}。

en: Recovery Room: {n} free treatments left today
zh_CN: 康复室：今天还剩 {n} 次免费治疗
奖励：{gold} 金币 · {xp} 经验 · {extra}

en: Specialties are used for quests, contracts, crafting, and egg recipes. Selling far from home pays more.
zh_CN: 特产可用于任务、委托、制作和孵蛋配方。在远离产地的地方出售更赚钱。

en: New sailors arrive on day {day}. Tavern level {level}.
zh_CN: 第 {day} 天会有新水手到来。酒馆等级 {level}。

en: Pass time to rotate taverns and contracts.
zh_CN: 消磨时间，让酒馆和委托轮换。

en: Each crew member picks the best skill for the moment.
zh_CN: 每名船员根据当下情况选择最佳技能。

en: Prefer stuns and slows; interrupt wind-ups.
zh_CN: 优先使用眩晕和减速；打断蓄力。
优先使用护盾、嘲讽和治疗。

en: Guard: may intercept hits for allies
zh_CN: 守护：可能替队友挡下攻击

en: Mend: basic attacks heal wounded allies
zh_CN: 疗愈：普通攻击会治疗受伤队友

en: Nourish: attacks also heal the weakest ally
zh_CN: 滋养：攻击同时治疗最虚弱的队友

en: Pet bond: companion acts faster and hits harder
zh_CN: 宠物羁绊：伙伴行动更快、打得更狠

en: Reach: strikes past the front line
Splash: hits others in the same lane
zh_CN: 溅射：波及同一排的其他敌人

en: Crushing depths over sealed ruins that silence skills.
zh_CN: 压得人喘不过气的深渊，海底的封印遗迹会封住技能。

en: Rich shoals ruled by old families and their mixed retinues.
zh_CN: 由古老世家及其混编随从统治的富饶浅滩。

en: Warm, calm waters where new captains learn the ropes.
zh_CN: 温暖平静的海域，新船长在这里学习航海。

en: Volcanic isles of forges and smoke, where decks catch fire.
zh_CN: 布满熔炉与烟雾的火山群岛，甲板会着火。

en: Crystal reefs that dazzle the eye and hide decoys.
zh_CN: 会让人目眩、暗藏诱饵的水晶礁。

en: The last sea, where only elite crews survive.
zh_CN: 最后的海域，只有精英船队才能生存。

en: A ring of reefs around a sleeping titan; enemies come in waves.
zh_CN: 环绕着沉睡巨兽的礁环；敌人会一波波袭来。

en: Silver waters where dreams drift and foes telegraph their blows.
zh_CN: 梦境漂浮的银色海域，敌人会预告他们的攻击。

en: A band of endless storms where lightning finds every mast.
zh_CN: 风暴永不停歇的海带，闪电会找上每一根桅杆。

en: A jungle sea of spores and roots that drains the unwary.
zh_CN: 充满孢子与根须的丛林之海，会让粗心的人精疲力竭。

en: Fast travel works between visited ports on a charted route and skips sea events.
zh_CN: 快速航行只能在已到访且航线已标记的港口之间进行，并会跳过海上事件。
首次到访：会发现附近的地点。

en: No known port to return to
zh_CN: 没有可返回的已知港口

en: After this leg you may not have enough food to sail back. Emergency Return is always free.
zh_CN: 这段航程之后，食物可能不够返航。紧急返航始终免费。

en: A sealed crate bobs in the swell of {region}.
zh_CN: 一只密封的木箱在{region}的浪涛中浮沉。

en: A bottle drifts by with a note about the creatures of {region}.
zh_CN: 一只漂流瓶漂过，里面的字条写着{region}生物的事情。

en: You may learn a pet family clue.
zh_CN: 你可能会得到一条宠物族群线索。

en: A patrol flying red pennants hails you in {region}.
zh_CN: 一支挂着红旗的巡逻队在{region}拦下了你。

en: Pay {n} gold, or refuse and lose 6 hours.
zh_CN: 缴纳 {n} 金币，或拒绝并耽误 6 小时。

en: Something huge rises from the waters of {region}.
zh_CN: 有个庞然大物从{region}的海水中升起。

en: Black sails close in across {region}. They mean to board.
zh_CN: 黑帆从{region}的海面逼近，他们要强行登船。

en: Your navigator spots a fast current through {region}.
zh_CN: 你的领航员在{region}发现了一股快速洋流。

en: Routes in this sea cost 1 less food; an uncharted place may be revealed.
zh_CN: 此海域内的航线少消耗 1 份食物；也许还会发现一个未标记的地点。

en: A small crew from {region} signals for help.
zh_CN: 一艘来自{region}的小船发出求救信号。

en: Helping costs 2 food and earns gold and goodwill.
zh_CN: 提供帮助需要 2 份食物，可获得金币和好感。
一场突如其来的暴风雨席卷了{region}。

en: Without a Navigator or Barricade Room, the hull takes damage and you lose 2 hours.
zh_CN: 如果没有领航员或防御工事舱，船体会受损并耽误 2 小时。

en: A complete record of Ashen Trench: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于灰烬海沟的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: Every chart in the known seas, bound by one patient hand.
zh_CN: 已知海域的每一张海图，被同一双耐心的手装订在一起。

en: A complete record of Crown Shoals: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于王冠浅滩的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: A complete record of Dawnwater: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于晨水湾的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: Trophies from the rarest things in the sea, and the patience it took to find them.
zh_CN: 来自海中极稀有之物的战利品，以及找到它们所需的耐心。

en: A complete record of Emberreach: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于烬火峡的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: A complete record of Glass Current: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于玻璃洋流的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: A complete record of Grand Horizon: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于大天际的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: A complete record of Leviathan Ring: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于利维坦环的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: A complete record of Moonwake: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于月醒海的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: Every small strange thing the sea gave up after a storm.
zh_CN: 每一场风暴后，海归还的每一件小小奇物。

en: A complete record of Stormbelt: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于风暴带的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: The crests of every great beast that rules a region.
zh_CN: 统治每一片海域的巨兽之冠。

en: A complete record of Verdant Maw: one relic, one trophy, one memory, one curiosity.
zh_CN: 关于翠喉的完整记录：一件遗物、一件战利品、一段记忆、一件奇物。

en: One relic from each shore, carried until the brass wore smooth.
zh_CN: 来自每一片海岸的一件遗物，被带到黄铜磨得光滑。

en: Sign on or let go first.
zh_CN: 请先决定招募或放其离开。
已拥有——转化为 {n} 枚古物碎片

en: {n} kinds of spoils were left on the field.
zh_CN: {n} 类战利品遗留在战场上。

en: No goods or gear this time.
Every berth is taken ({n} / {max}). Free a berth or enlarge the quarters to sign on new crew; this one goes ashore.
zh_CN: 床位已满（{n} / {max}）。腾出床位或扩建船员舱才能招收新船员；此人将上岸离开。

en: No defeated foe asked to join this time.
zh_CN: 这次没有战败者请求加入。

en: A defeated {enemy} lays down arms and asks to sign on.
zh_CN: 战败的{enemy}放下武器，请求加入船队。

en: Sea chest full: salvaged for {n} materials.
zh_CN: 装备箱已满：拆解为 {n} 材料。

en: {name} signed on and took a free berth.
zh_CN: {name} 加入船队，住进了空床位。

en: Spoils picked up from fallen foes. They are counted and stored in the report after the battle.
zh_CN: 从倒下的敌人身上拾得的战利品，战斗结束后在报告中清点入库。

en: +{n} XP for the crew who fought
Click a free cell to place {facility}. Press R to rotate.
zh_CN: 点击空格子放置 {facility}。按 R 旋转。

en: Rooms are built on interior levels below the weather deck. The weather deck stays clear for crew movement and boarding fights; only naval fittings go there.
zh_CN: 房间建在露天甲板下方的船舱楼层。露天甲板留给船员通行和接舷战，只能放置船具。

en: Bulkhead wall on the {deck}, row {y}. Add a door to walk through it.
zh_CN: {deck}第 {y} 行的舱壁。加装一扇门才能通过。

en: Click a facility or a sailor aboard to inspect it.
zh_CN: 点击船上的设施或船员即可查看。

en: Heavy damage: departures cost extra food until repaired.
zh_CN: 严重损伤：修复前出航会额外消耗食物。

en: Damaged: works at half effect until repaired.
zh_CN: 已损坏：修复前效果减半。

en: It has no effect until it is connected again.
zh_CN: 重新连通之前，它不会产生任何效果。

en: Click a bulkhead cell to add or remove a door.
zh_CN: 点击隔舱壁格子以添加或移除舱门。

en: Door in the bulkhead on the {deck}, row {y}.
Layout can only be edited at a port
Facilities are moved to the hold and can be placed again on the larger decks. Crew, cargo, and progress carry over.
zh_CN: 设施会被移入货舱，可在更大的甲板上重新放置。船员、货物和进度都会保留。

en: Interior level: cabins, galley, workshops, storage and other rooms. Upper decks are cut away while this level is shown.
zh_CN: 船舱楼层：卧舱、厨房、工坊、仓储等房间。显示此层时，上层甲板会被剖开隐藏。

en: PgUp/PgDn or Tab: change level · Home: fit view
zh_CN: PgUp/PgDn 或 Tab：切换楼层 · Home：适配画面

en: Exposed decks: circulation, rigging and the boarding fight. Only fittings such as the lookout, boarding gate and guard post may stand here.
zh_CN: 露天甲板用于通行、操帆和接舷战。这里只能放置瞭望台、接舷门、警戒哨等船具。

en: Click a free cell to move {facility}.
Save the current layout and restore it later. Applying a preset only moves facilities you own.
zh_CN: 保存当前布局，之后可以恢复。应用预设只会移动你已拥有的设施。

en: Galley turns gold into food and the Workshop turns materials into supplies, even at sea.
zh_CN: 厨房可以把金币变成食物，工坊可以把材料变成补给，即使在海上也能进行。

en: You get back {gold} gold and {materials} materials.
zh_CN: 你将取回 {gold} 金币和 {materials} 材料。

en: Select a facility, door, or stair on the deck plan.
zh_CN: 在甲板图上选择一个设施、门或楼梯。

en: Click a cell to add a ladder and hatch up to the level above, or click an open-deck edge beside a raised deck for a stair.
zh_CN: 点击格子，添加通往上一层的梯子和舱口；或点击紧邻高层甲板的露天甲板边缘放置楼梯。

en: Ladder or stair from the {a} up to the {b}.
Store it in the hold. Stowed facilities keep their level but have no effect.
zh_CN: 收进货舱。收起的设施保留等级，但不产生效果。

en: The Tidebound Society wants samples from deep inside {location}.
zh_CN: 潮缚学会想要 {location} 深处的样本。

en: Old songs speak of a hidden place: find {location}.
zh_CN: 古老的歌谣提到一处隐秘之地：找到 {location}。

en: Clear {location} so the League can build an outpost.
zh_CN: 清理 {location}，好让联盟建立前哨。

en: Recover what the wreck at {location} still holds.
